Get transcripts each speaker appears in

Source: R/get_transcript_speakers.R
get_transcript_speakers.Rd

Loads the bundled speakers_per_transcript dataset and returns one row per unique speaker with a list-column of the transcript IDs where that speaker appears. Optionally filters to only transcripts matching specific IDs and/or topics.

Usage

get_transcript_speakers(id = NULL, topic = NULL)

Arguments

id

Optional numeric vector of transcript IDs to restrict results to (e.g., 1, c(1, 5, 10)).

topic

Optional character vector of one or more topic names (e.g., "media", c("reelection", "state_capture")). The topic_ prefix is added automatically if not included. Only transcripts where all of these topics are flagged are included.

Value

A tibble with columns:

  • speaker_std (character): standardized speaker identifier

  • transcripts (list): sorted numeric vector of transcript IDs where the speaker appears

Details

All filters are combined with AND logic: a transcript contributes speakers only if it matches the specified IDs and has every specified topic flagged. When only one filter is provided, it is applied alone. When neither is provided, all speakers across all transcripts are returned. Requesting a combination that never co-occurs returns a zero-row tibble.

See also

read_transcripts(), get_transcript_id(), get_transcripts_raw()

Examples

# Get all speakers and their transcript appearances
speakers <- get_transcript_speakers()
head(speakers)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   speaker_std      transcripts
#>   <chr>            <list>     
#> 1 aguirre          <dbl [1]>  
#> 2 albarracin       <dbl [2]>  
#> 3 alberto kouri    <dbl [1]>  
#> 4 alex kouri       <dbl [7]>  
#> 5 alvarado cabrera <dbl [1]>  
#> 6 americano        <dbl [1]>  

# Get speakers from specific transcripts
get_transcript_speakers(id = c(1, 5))
#> # A tibble: 9 × 2
#>   speaker_std transcripts
#>   <chr>       <list>     
#> 1 alex kouri  <dbl [1]>  
#> 2 borobio     <dbl [1]>  
#> 3 colunge     <dbl [1]>  
#> 4 desconocido <dbl [2]>  
#> 5 huaman      <dbl [1]>  
#> 6 ibarcena    <dbl [1]>  
#> 7 menendez    <dbl [1]>  
#> 8 montesinos  <dbl [2]>  
#> 9 solis       <dbl [1]>  

# Get speakers from transcripts about media
get_transcript_speakers(topic = "media")
#> # A tibble: 60 × 2
#>    speaker_std   transcripts
#>    <chr>         <list>     
#>  1 alex kouri    <dbl [4]>  
#>  2 arancibia     <dbl [1]>  
#>  3 arce          <dbl [1]>  
#>  4 bedoya        <dbl [2]>  
#>  5 bello vasquez <dbl [3]>  
#>  6 bertini       <dbl [2]>  
#>  7 bolona        <dbl [1]>  
#>  8 borobio       <dbl [3]>  
#>  9 bringas       <dbl [1]>  
#> 10 calmell       <dbl [5]>  
#> # ℹ 50 more rows

# Get speakers from transcripts about both media and reelection
get_transcript_speakers(topic = c("media", "reelection"))
#> # A tibble: 23 × 2
#>    speaker_std        transcripts
#>    <chr>              <list>     
#>  1 alex kouri         <dbl [2]>  
#>  2 arce               <dbl [1]>  
#>  3 bello vasquez      <dbl [3]>  
#>  4 bolona             <dbl [1]>  
#>  5 bringas            <dbl [1]>  
#>  6 calmell            <dbl [1]>  
#>  7 campos             <dbl [1]>  
#>  8 chirinos           <dbl [1]>  
#>  9 crnl ramirez       <dbl [1]>  
#> 10 crousillat carreno <dbl [1]>  
#> # ℹ 13 more rows

# Get speakers from transcript 2, which is also about media
get_transcript_speakers(id = 2, topic = "media")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   speaker_std transcripts
#>   <chr>       <list>     
#> 1 montesinos  <dbl [1]>  
#> 2 ricketts    <dbl [1]>
